bio.text: David C. Farnsworth represents Legislative District 10 in the Arizona Senate, where he chairs the Appropriations, Transportation and Technology Committee and the Rules Committee.
According to his legislative biography, he was born in Mexico City, graduated from Mesa High School, and earned an A.A. degree from Mesa Community College in 1979.

The biography says his career included owning a real estate investment and rental management business and other commercial ventures, and working as a licensed real estate and insurance agent and as a supervisor for Home Depot.
